# Builder

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Builder`](gmeow-Builder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Builder>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The build system or agent that performs a [`BuildActivity`](gmeow-BuildActivity.md) — e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Buildkite, or a local make invocation. A [`SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) scoped to the build role.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Builder`](gmeow-Builder.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
